name: Itsu made mo Musuko no Mama ja Irarenai! 5 ~Kyonyuu Ottori Mama no Attaka Oppai ni Tsutsumare nagara Amaetai!~
original_name: いつまでも息子のままじゃいられない！5 ～巨乳おっとりママのあったかおっぱいに包まれながら甘えたいっ！～
source: Koshimizu Sou lives with his widowed mother Sanae. Sou is incredibly short, far too short for a boy of his age so his mother agrees to help him do exercises and stretches to help his body grow. Doing stretches with his mother makes him incredibly excited and he can't hide his erection from her. Sanae takes it on herself to relieve her son whenever he gets too excited as they exercise together. Eventually the excitement gets too unbearable for both of them and they cross a forbidden line together.
translation: 小清水壮和丧偶的母亲早苗住在一起。苏非常矮，对于他这个年纪的男孩来说太矮了，所以他的母亲同意帮助他做运动和伸展运动，以帮助他的身体成长。和他的母亲一起做伸展运动让他非常兴奋，他无法向她隐瞒自己的勃起。每当儿子在他们一起锻炼时过于兴奋时，早苗就会亲自去安慰他。最终，两人都难以忍受兴奋，一起跨越了禁线。
